name: EgoDex
tagline: 829 h / 338K episodes of 1080p 30 Hz Apple Vision Pro video on 194 tabletop tasks, with ARKit 3D hand, upper-body and camera poses.

annotations.format: HDF5 per episode (SE(3) joint transforms, confidences, llm_description attr) paired with MP4
annotations.coverageNote: Each episode: MP4 + HDF5 with 30 Hz SE(3) transforms (camera, 25 joints per hand, upper body) and a GPT-4 task description. 725 h train / 7 h test / 97 h extra.

narrations.note: One task-level description per episode, not timestamped

action_labels.note: Task folder = one of 194 tabletop tasks per episode (no temporal segments)

hand_pose.note: 25 joints per hand as 4x4 transforms per frame (ARKit), optional confidences

body_pose.note: Upper-body joints (hip, spine, neck, shoulders, arms, wrists) per frame

camera_pose.note: camera 4x4 transform per frame (ARKit) + fixed 3x3 intrinsics

qa_language.note: f.attrs['llm_description'] (GPT-4 merge of collector metadata) per episode

annotations.sample:
# <task>/<i>.hdf5  (paired with <task>/<i>.mp4; N = 30 * seconds)
camera
└── intrinsic            # 3 x 3, identical in every file
transforms               # each N x 4 x 4 SE(3), ARKit origin frame
├── camera
├── leftHand
├── rightHand
├── leftIndexFingerTip
└── ... (64 more joints)
confidences              # optional, each N scalars in [0, 1]
├── leftHand
└── ...
attrs: llm_description   # + llm_description2 for reversible tasks
